### Searching for Lost Sheep
Author: Alistair Begg
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/truth-for-life/truth-for-life-june-26-2023.html
Passage: John 9:35
Points:
- Jesus' encounter with the outcast blind man fits into God's eternal redemptive plan to gather people from every nation.
- Christ deliberately seeks out and welcomes those whom society rejects and casts aside.
- Followers of Jesus are called to follow His pattern by actively reaching out to the broken, hurting, and marginalized.
- Remembering our own past lostness and Christ's grace motivates us to share the gospel with others.

### Even if it Takes a Miracle
Author: Meg Bucher
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/your-daily-bible-verse/even-if-it-takes-a-miracle-bible-study-minute-september-6-2018.html
Passage: John 9:35
Points:
- Human efforts to explain everything with rigid rules fail to grasp God's supernatural power and timing.
- The Pharisees allowed skepticism and legalism to blind them to the obvious work of God.
- Amid religious controversy and rejection, Jesus personally sought out the healed man to confirm his faith.
- Skepticism from others cannot erase what God has done, proving that no one is beyond Christ's reach.
